Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: Ah, I'm not the only one that has seen the Tiny Cave.

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: Let me guess, you tried to squeeze yourself though the entrance?

Dialog.Name: Vows
Dialog.Text: No, I didn't try that yet.

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: It's not a good idea, I've already tried it with no luck.

Dialog.Name: Vows
Dialog.Text: Can you help me get inside?

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: Sure. I can whip up any potion to suit your needs.

Dialog.Name: Vows
Dialog.Text: What do you need from me?

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: Since, it's a simple potion, all I need is 5 Undine Mushrooms. They used to be a rare type of mushroom, but suddenly they've been sprouting up only at this village. If you're lucky you will find several just outside that door.

Dialog.Name: Vows
Dialog.Text: Okay. I'll be right back.

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: I told you it wasn't that hard to collect.

Dialog.Name: Kiril
Dialog.Text: Now go explore that cave! I gave you enough potion to explore the area several times.
